name: vesper-production
description: VESPER Production Suite - Local-First Context-Aware AI Voice & Desktop Action Platform
author: VESPER Team

scripts.build: electron-vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); if(fs.existsSync('src/main/detect-window.exe')) fs.copyFileSync('src/main/detect-window.exe', 'out/main/detect-window.exe'); if(fs.existsSync('src/main/send-input.exe')) fs.copyFileSync('src/main/send-input.exe', 'out/main/send-input.exe'); const binDir='out/bin'; if(!fs.existsSync(binDir)) fs.mkdirSync(binDir, {recursive:true}); const wks=fs.existsSync('src/main/WinKeyServer.exe') ? 'src/main/WinKeyServer.exe' : 'resources/bin/WinKeyServer.exe'; if(fs.existsSync(wks)) { fs.copyFileSync(wks, 'out/bin/WinKeyServer.exe'); }"
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && electron-builder --win --config.directories.output="%TEMP%/vesper-dist" && node -e "const fs=require('fs'), path=require('path'); const src=path.join(process.env.TEMP, 'vesper-dist'); fs.mkdirSync('dist', {recursive:true}); const d='../launchpad/public/downloads'; fs.mkdirSync(d, {recursive:true}); fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src, 'VESPER-Setup-1.0.0.exe'), 'dist/VESPER-Setup-1.0.0.exe'); if(fs.existsSync(path.join(src, 'VESPER-Setup-1.0.0.exe.blockmap'))) fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src, 'VESPER-Setup-1.0.0.exe.blockmap'), 'dist/VESPER-Setup-1.0.0.exe.blockmap'); fs.copyFileSync(path.join(src, 'VESPER-Setup-1.0.0.exe'), path.join(d, 'VESPER-Setup-1.0.0.exe'));"
